title: Mercury in 3D, the clear-glass polish: the reference, Cycles (this pass's model), and live in the widget's renderer (the studio behind; and over a dark desktop), half size
notes: part: 1. Over a dark desktop it now glows, much nearer the reference: the hot lines glow inside the glass (never outside the outline), the rolls keep their own rose light, the desktop still shows through the middles, a white page still near 40%. Left: the outline's light still reads as an even rose band in places, fewer deep darks beside the highlights than the reference, the channel round the wells busier with thin lines.

part: 2. The cover sits on the ridge in a pocket round on every side; the art is now carried round the ring (mirrored across the pocket's wall, fading) as well as its glow; fainter and less vivid than the reference's marble.

ok: 3. The ridge is one roll along your trace: under the cover, level under the words, up through the twist (its start eased 8 to 12 px down and right, where the reference's crest runs), the sheet's lip over the wells, into the tail tip.
part: 4. The twist, the sheet over the wells, three round wells with dark middles and warm rims; the right end's curl is still gentler than the reference's (not worked on this round).

ok: 5. Words and controls crisp and readable over dark, a light wallpaper and a white window. The twist's hot line now clears the title's last letter (by about 6 px at real size); no line crosses the artist or the times.
ok: 6. Zebra smooth in Blender and live; the live normals now continuous across voxels (the saw-tooth in the hot line is gone), the bulb's left side ironed.

part: 7. 59.4 fps at the widget's real size (125%, drawn at 2150 x 1000) using 3.5% of the GPU, 4.0% with refraction on, measured while a game held the card at 99% (two earlier runs gave 56 to 57 fps as the game's load moved; the cap is 60; the new glow costs no measurable share); 0% when still, 0.2% with refraction. Audio not part of this still.
